plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build efficient damage to cross the 160-HP stun threshold early, sustained scaling afterward, reliable weakness and block. Preserve a useful boss potion and healthy entry HP.
plan.summary: Add immediate damage before speculative combos, then scaling and efficient defense. Avoid unprepared elites, remove surplus starters, and upgrade core cards when healing is unnecessary.

plan.archetype: Efficient damage with poison, Serpent Form, and dexterity defense
